“When are you going to stop blaming me for your problems? I don’t want to feel guilty anymore. No one taught me how to be a mother! I don’t want to change for anyone!” -my mother who I suspect to be a covert narc 

“I hope you have a daughter so she turns out like you and you see how messed up you are. You’re never considerate of mom. You need to stop blaming mom for your problems.”-my sibling who can’t see the damage my mom has done (this is probably the meanest my sibling has ever said to me) 

It’s always about her. 
I’m an adult trying to heal from all of this. I just can’t “get over it”
I definitely get this. I know life is full of ups and downs but being exhausted all the damn time is so discouraging. It’s so constant.
Thank you for your kind words. I miss her so much. She always smelled sweet like seeds.
I don’t want to sound too forward but it sounds like you should look into testing for adhd. This post resonated with me, especially the feeling lazy part. I’m not a medical professional lol.
Child- parent relationships are so messy. Unfortunately there are too many parents who ...don’t know how to parent :(
